profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Meta
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer, manager, and tech lead with a proven track record of delivering products for startups and large enterprises alike. I enjoy leading trainings and talks and I love improving both user and developer experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: SWE at Meta Reality Labs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: (acq. by Meta) Building a web app, Mac app, Windows app, and a wearable to power your personalized AI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Delivering carbon-reducing software using AI-driven reporting, product matching, and emissions reductions.
* Leading technical initiatives end-to-end.
* Customer-facing sales engineering directly growing revenue.

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
I took a quick break from work to attend Deep Atlas in San Francisco for two weeks. Deep Atlas is an intense, full-time/onsite 'bootcamp' for software engineers to learn AI/ML, taught by the founders of Hack Reactor.

* Built deep and shallow models
* Transfer learning and fine-tuning
* Principles and theory of machine learning (and even the math)

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Managed teams hands-on to rebuild core UX as microfrontends with matching thin backends, earning millions in new business via custom integrations and deploying these MFEs into 3P systems. Personally wrote IaC and CI/CD pipelines. Cemented backends-for-frontends as our standard pattern, which is still in use today.
* Led architecture and execution of greenfield React SPA to launch a new financing vertical (home improvement lending), resulting in home improvement’s and my software’s share of company revenue generation growing from <5% to ~40% under my leadership.
* Shipped new global app authentication using an advanced implementation of OAuth 2.0 in 1 quarter, leveraging Auth0 and Salesforce SSO, in place of an outdated internal user DB; brought CRM and user identity management together via SFDC.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Tech lead on a greenfield point-of-sale web portal (React, Apollo, Scala, GraphQL, Sangria) built to launch a new product vertical; the vertical's annual share of company revenue generation grew by 800% during my tenure
* Led code reviews, created tech design documents (ERDs), and defined code architecture
* Maintained Python/CloudFormation/CodePipeline release pipeline

positions.title: Co-Founder & Lead Engineer
positions.description: Helped launch a new startup in a super-innovative space.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · Scrum · SQL · Version Control · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
* Led the engineering practice of 2 dozen domestic engineers, including direct management of 5 engineers.
* Honed hiring processes, coordinated interviews, and directly interviewed candidates.
* Billed software development (architecture and execution) 40+ hours a week.
* Assisted business development by presenting technical architecture and other solutions for Fortune 500 companies (names upon request).

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Skills: Unit Testing · Scrum · SQL · Version Control · AWS Lambda · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Acq. by Inspire11
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · SQL · Version Control · AWS Lambda · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
* Led engineering at startup delivering innovative React Native mobile application for student financial literacy.
* Hands-on user experience with underserved high-school students in Chicago with a personal finance curriculum.
* Shipped backend with infrastructure in Node and Firebase/Firestore.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · SQL · Version Control

positions.title: Product Lead
positions.description:
* Architecture, product scoping, and software for startup clients; used React, Ruby, Swift, Java, Python, PHP, AWS, Heroku.
* Led scaling refactor of Ruby on Rails backend for hellobar.com during a period of rapid growth.
* Advised startup founders on technical and architecture decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · SQL · Version Control

company.name: Polymathic - Software Consulting for Industry Ventures

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
* Successfully raise 750k pre-seed round (this was 2010!) from Silicon Valley investors including DFJ, First Round Capital and Lightbank
* Integrated third-party APIs (Google Chat, Facebook Chat, XMPP, etc). Wrote key-value database and OAuth client in Objective-C.
* Built an iOS mobile application during the early days of the App Store. (Objective-C didn’t even have automatic reference counting!)

positions.title: Media Intern
positions.description: Motion graphics and 3D modeling

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer mentor for iMentor, a national non-profit that connects working mentors to high-schoolers. A 3-year commitment, mentors converse with their mentee regularly and help guide them to their ideal post-secondary outcome like a four-year or junior college.

I've always been interested in teaching, and I was proud to be able to teach video game design for Citizen Schools. We worked with about 30 Chicago middle schoolers over a ten week program. We formed a curriculum around MIT Scratch, which helps kids learn to code, visually.
